title: El legado populista
goal: Read a balanced closing verdict on populism's legacy -- real material gains alongside weakened democratic institutions -- and how its influence outlasted the leaders themselves.

items: State the undeniable achievement of these populist movements.
Name another country besides Argentina and Mexico where a comparable movement arose.
Explain whether these leaders' influence survived their exit from power.
Explain why reducing populism to heroes and villains is a mistake.
Use si bien... también es cierto que to hold two competing truths in balance.
